snippet.title: Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault Trailer
snippet.description:
For more information, please visit: http://aksysgames.com/aepa/
_____________________________________________________________________________
Aksys Games and Acquire proudly present Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault, a frenetic and explosive new spin on action strategy gaming NOW available on on PlayStation®4 Computer Entertainment System, PlayStation®3 Computer Entertainment System and PlayStation®Vita handheld entertainment system.

Dig in, plan out and build up your defenses as hordes of hulking monstrosities bombard your heavily fortified city in an attempt to wipe you off the Earth for good! Command the last bastion of humanity as you fight for the survival of the species utilizing fantastic tech, cunning tactics and massive weapons in an all-out action strategy extravaganza!
